svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner
svg.desc: Landing page: one-line promise, flow from import to printed move list drawn as a drawing set, open-the-demo action, and a plan drawing with revision clouds.
svg.text: Smart Warehouse Planner reads your Locations, Inventory and Transactions files,
classifies every part by its picks, and suggests moves in rounds. Each move
names its rule and its numbers. The tool suggests; you decide.
Every recommendation shows its rule and the figures behind it.
Moves live in a planning copy. Your import and your main system never change.
Walk Path is an order, not a distance: no metres-saved or capacity claims.
NOT TO SCALE — Walk Path order only. Data as of 2026-09-30.
Six sheets from export to the aisle floor
The same order the app walks you through, one sheet at a time.
Apply, adjust or keep in place.
Per aisle: what moves in and
Smart Warehouse Planner · IBE160 course project · synthetic demo data only
